▶ ABOUT PLUMB’S

Plumb’s™ is a trusted, easy-to-use clinical decision support tool that helps animal care teams make confident decisions for every patient—from diagnosis to discharge. A staple in veterinary practices and teaching hospitals for more than 30 years, this trusted reference book has evolved into a continually updated, easy-to-use platform where veterinarians can find all the information they need to work up cases in one place—where they’re already going every day for trusted drug information. Plumb’s™ is developed, reviewed, and verified by boarded veterinary experts and practicing veterinarians, so busy animal care teams can trust the answers they find to help them make confident decisions for their animal patients.
